cohort: 95,728 women with singleton pregnancies (911 with ICP) in 14 hospitals in China
finding: Intrahepatic cholestasis of pregnancy (ICP) was associated with an increased risk of GDM, preeclampsia, cesarean delivery, iatrogenic preterm delivery, and NICU admission.
mod_finding: Women with intrahepatic cholestasis of pregnancy (ICP) had significantly higher rates of scheduled cesarean deliveries and cesarean deliveries during labor compared to women without ICP.
